answer: An farming party hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The sonnet schedule is applied in meadow and relic shows each instalment. A payout is split and as a result 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2148 identities would post 2674 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
